description: International trade systems, agreements, organizations, and economic impacts

trade_theory.absolute_advantage: Adam Smith; produce what you produce better than others in absolute terms
trade_theory.comparative_advantage: Ricardo; produce what you produce at lowest opportunity cost; basis for free trade
trade_theory.heckscher_ohlin: Countries export goods that use their abundant factors intensively (labor vs capital)
trade_theory.new_trade_theory: Economies of scale and product differentiation explain much of modern trade; Krugman

trade_organizations.imf: International Monetary Fund; 190 members; financial stability; balance of payments support
trade_organizations.world_bank: Development financing; poverty reduction; project loans
trade_organizations.unctad: UN Conference on Trade and Development; trade and development for developing countries

types.fta: Free Trade Agreement; eliminates tariffs between signatories
types.common_market: Customs union + free movement of factors

major_agreements.eu: European Union; single market; 27 members; customs union; free movement
major_agreements.cptpp: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership; 11 Pacific nations
major_agreements.rcep: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership; Asia-Pacific; world's largest FTA by population
major_agreements.afcfta: African Continental Free Trade Area; 55 countries; 2019

supply_chains.global_value_chains: Production fragmented across countries; iPhone components from 43 countries
supply_chains.just_in_time: Minimize inventory; disrupted by COVID-19; supply chain resilience now priority
supply_chains.nearshoring: Trend to move production closer to consumers; reduce dependence on distant suppliers

critical_supply_chains.semiconductors: Taiwan (TSMC) produces ~54% of world's chips; US CHIPS Act response
critical_supply_chains.rare_earth: China controls ~85% of processing; critical for electronics and EVs
critical_supply_chains.food: Russia-Ukraine supply 30% of global wheat; 2022 war caused food price crisis

trade_and_development.export_led_growth: East Asian miracle; South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore grew via exports
trade_and_development.dutch_disease: Resource boom causes currency appreciation; crowds out manufacturing
trade_and_development.race_to_bottom: Countries compete by lowering labor/environmental standards for investment
trade_and_development.fair_trade: Movement ensuring producers in developing countries receive fair prices
